base_branch_rationale: Wave C validates a topology against the environment profile wave B shipped, so it branches from wave B.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: A validated solution manifest with a closed key set, an edition that changes only capabilities, offline validation and planning, conflict reporting over scopes, planes, structure roles and packages before any mutation, a topology validated against the distributed entitlement and the environment profile, an assistant profile that may only narrow, and the Docara and Tracker manifests as fixtures.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: executing an install or an upgrade
any network access from a validator or a planner
letting an edition change packages, scopes, planes or roles
letting an assistant profile add an operation or raise a risk class
accepting a manifest that declares raw SQL or a direct table write
accepting a multi-node topology without the distributed entitlement
adding a table or a migration
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/licensing, larena/storage or any package other than larena/core
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing core style; no database.
required_tests: a manifest validates offline and an unknown top-level key is refused
an edition that changes only the capability set is accepted and one that changes packages, scopes, planes or roles is refused
two solutions conflicting on a scope, a plane, a structure role and a package are each reported before any mutation
an upgrade that would move the base solution outside its declared range is refused
a manifest declaring raw SQL or a direct table write is refused
an assistant profile that adds an operation or raises a risk class is refused, and one that narrows is accepted
a single-node topology needs no entitlement; a two-node topology is refused without distributed.remote_operations and accepted with it
a node with no public surface is marked headless and the marker is declared rather than inferred
a topology whose node requires a capability the environment profile lacks is refused naming the capability
the Docara and Tracker fixtures both validate and plan
smoke_plan: Validation, planning and topology validation executed with no network available, and core:operations:coverage showing the solution codes as covered.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen manifest key set, conflict class, reason code or topology rule would have to change
a validator or planner would need network access
an install or upgrade would have to execute
a table or migration would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave C plans and validates. It installs nothing.
The two manifests it ships are fixtures, not installed solutions.
